# Face photos

The tests and `app/demo_data.py` use these photos. Each one is a U.S. government portrait, so it is in the public domain. `ride.jpg`, `ochoa.jpg` and `glenn.jpg` are the 500 px versions from Wikimedia Commons.

| File | Person | Source |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `armstrong_1.jpg`, `armstrong_2.jpg` | Neil Armstrong | NASA portrait |
| `jemison.jpg` | Mae Jemison | NASA portrait |
| `ride.jpg` | Sally Ride | NASA portrait, [File:Sally Ride (1984).jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sally_Ride_(1984).jpg) |
| `ochoa.jpg` | Ellen Ochoa | NASA portrait, [File:Ellen Ochoa.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ellen_Ochoa.jpg) |
| `glenn.jpg` | John Glenn | U.S. Senate portrait, [File:John Glenn Low Res.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:John_Glenn_Low_Res.jpg) |

Every photo has one face. The faces of different people score below the match threshold (0.363), so no person matches another.
